text:
sara_ops: DeployBot kicked off v2 rollout to EU pool-3 and ops dash shows a jump in 422s for /v2/stream. can we pause the pool? :eyes:

deploybot: roll id=rb-1788889999 started -> pool-3 (10%). error_rate(/v2/stream)=6.3% (alert threshold=1%).

anna_prodeng: quick traces show truncated stream frames for very long sessions (>6k tokens). sample: `Error: invalid_chunk_size at chunk 37`.

jon_sre: likely a chunked transfer parsing mismatch with older edge proxies. do we have tenant correlation?

emma_support: affected tenants: 5555, 6666 seeing most failures.

sara_ops: pausing pool-3 now: `deploybot pause rb-1788889999 --pool pool-3`.

deploybot: pause applied for pool-3; rollout halted for that pool.

mike_release: decision: rollback v2 for region or pin impacted tenants to v1 while we hotpatch? need comms and release notes update either way.

anna_prodeng: root cause: new frame boundary calc hits quantization boundary. short-term mitigation: enable legacy chunker for long contexts. I can build a hotpatch image and push to canaries in ~30m.

jon_sre: hotpatch path OK. pin tenants to v1 during patch for deterministic behavior.

sara_ops: pinning now: `deploybot pin-tenant 5555 --api v1` and `deploybot pin-tenant 6666 --api v1`.

deploybot: tenants 5555, 6666 pinned to v1 (cfg commit cfg-abb123).

kate_pm: drafting customer note: "We're pausing the EU v2 streaming rollout due to chunking errors on very long sessions. You're pinned to v1 while we deploy a fix. No action required." will add ETA once hotpatch is building.

anna_prodeng: patch plan: build runtime flag `--chunker=legacy-longcontext`, deploy to 2 canaries, run 100 long-context synthetic checks, promote if green.

deploybot: canary update: rb-1788889999-canary-01 -> runtime v2.1-hotpatch.

jon_sre: canary smoke: 100 long-context streams -> 0 invalid_chunk_size so far. 15m soak in progress.

sara_ops: monitoring dashboards and logs for `invalid_chunk_size`. ready to unpin after verification.

anna_prodeng: hotpatch validated on canary, promoting to pool-3 staged rollout.

sara_ops: unpinning tenants: `deploybot unpin-tenant 5555` `deploybot unpin-tenant 6666`.

deploybot: tenants 5555, 6666 unpinned.

sara_ops: resuming rollout to pool-3 at 10%: `deploybot resume rb-1788889999 --pool pool-3 --start 10%`.

deploybot: rollout resumed for pool-3.
